label: copy phase: echoed input l (mid/late recall, not last step)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and only when the fed-back input is the letter l (98% of activation mass; in_tok l has 31x lift). It never fires in the original or delimiter phase, and never on the first occurrence of a token. Activation is concentrated at recall_idx 3-5 (t 10-13) and is weak or absent at recall_idx <= 2 and on the final output step. Magnitude depends strongly on the token being output next: the strongest activations (near max) are l followed by v (the l v v pattern), and out_tok v gives about 70% precision. Other outputs (s, w, c, n) give moderate activation. Precision is only about 0.4: many copy-phase l inputs at mid positions stay inactive, which points to further dependence on the upcoming output token that a single coherent predicate does not capture.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: l, v, c, w, s, x; least: u, 2, p, 1) and the token being output (most: v, l, s, w, c, n; least: r, 0, p, -); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=3, recall_idx=4, t=12.
